channel.title: Laws of AI Evaluation: changelog
channel.description: What changed on Laws of AI Evaluation.

item.title: Added question lists for buying an AI model or vendor, running a launch review, and building an evaluation, each drawn from the laws.
item.description: Added question lists for buying an AI model or vendor, running a launch review, and building an evaluation, each drawn from the laws.

item.title: Checked the figures and findings on the law pages against their sources (no discrepancies found) and tested every source link. Added Methodology and Privacy pages, a “Where this doesn’t apply” section on every law, and a “Report it” link for corrections.
item.description: Checked the figures and findings on the law pages against their sources (no discrepancies found) and tested every source link. Added Methodology and Privacy pages, a “Where this doesn’t apply” section on every law, and a “Report it” link for corrections.

item.title: Added Find your laws: describe your situation with an AI system and get the laws worth checking first, why each applies, and a question to ask.
item.description: Added Find your laws: describe your situation with an AI system and get the laws worth checking first, why each applies, and a question to ask.

item.title: The site now has its own home at lawsofaievaluation.com.
item.description: The site now has its own home at lawsofaievaluation.com.

item.title: Added My laws and the quick brief: collect any laws, then get a short overview built from each law's own text.
item.description: Added My laws and the quick brief: collect any laws, then get a short overview built from each law's own text.

item.title: Launched with all 26 laws, the claim checker, the printable checklist builder, and search.
item.description: Launched with all 26 laws, the claim checker, the printable checklist builder, and search.

item.title: Added the Design Rubric and the Readiness Review as reference pages. Interactive scoring is not built yet.
item.description: Added the Design Rubric and the Readiness Review as reference pages. Interactive scoring is not built yet.
